propositions: The fixture's _git() helper discards git stdout and stderr on failure, making it impossible to distinguish between genuine merge conflicts, hook failures, and unresolvable merge arguments when git exits with rc=1.

A content conflict in the merge history is structurally impossible because both branches write byte-identical bytes to the single shared path (1500-shared01-STATUS.json) and git merge-tree --write-tree returns rc=0 with zero conflicts.

The fixture destroys diagnostic evidence by using capture_output=True without rendering captured stderr in CalledProcessError's message, so the true cause of the observed rc=1 exit cannot be determined from CI logs.

Approximately 29,400 reproduction attempts (1,500 git sequence replays, 40 serial module runs, 72 oversubscribed runs, 3 full test rounds under xdist) produced zero recurrences, indicating either an extremely rare race condition or a transient external factor.
